messages.author: 2734d59aee5d72a5
messages.subject: Annual survival rate?
parts:
Hi all

I have ocelot (Leopardus pardalis) data from seven systematic camera trap surveys. These surveys were realized in 2004, 2006, 2008, 2010, 2014, 2016 and 2018. I am fitting openCR models to estimate mainly survival and growth rate, using JSSAsecrlCL model type.

I am using the “intervals” function to indicate the time between primary sessions: 

intervals(oce4a)<-c(698,419,843,1150,755,670)/365

My question is, the survival rate I am obtaining is the annual survival rate? Or is it estimated on a different time scale?

Many thanks

Paula

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Annual survival rate?
parts:
Should be annual survival if the intervals are in years. Does that not look right?
Murray
